The '''Barronite mace''' is a crush melee weapon that can be obtained within the [[Ruins of Camdozaal]], requiring 40 [[Attack]] to wield. Its bonuses are comparable to that of a [[rune mace]], but it provides higher melee strength and crush accuracy bonuses at the cost of a lower prayer bonus. It also has a 15% damage and accuracy bonus against [[Golem (attribute)|golem]]s, including those within the dungeon. Unlike regular metal maces, the barronite mace offers [[blunt]] rather than [[Weapons/Types#Spiked weapons|spiked]] attack styles, which means it can only be used for [[crush]] attacks, despite having a notable [[stab]] accuracy bonus. For [[free-to-play]] and low level players, this mace is a good alternative to the [[rune scimitar]] when fighting golems thanks to its [[Golem (attribute)|golembane]] effect and it is the second-best free-to-play weapon in most other situations, outperforming the [[rune sword]] in both strength and attack bonus. For those with membership, the golembane effect stacks with the [[black mask]] or [[slayer helmet]] effect while on a [[Gargoyle]] slayer task. 

When lost during [[PvM]], the mace goes to the [[gravestone]] and does not require repair. In a [[PvP]] death, the mace will be broken and will require 10,500 coins fee to be repaired, while the killer will receive 10,500 coins as additional loot.

The mace can be crafted by handing 3 distinct pieces of the mace to [[Ramarno]] along with 1,500 [[barronite shards]]. Note that the shards already stored in the [[Sacred Forge]] [[Ramarno's Shard Exchange|shop]] will '''not''' count towards these 1,500; one would have to ''Empty'' the forge to get the shards back. Activating the [[Charm of Luck|luck buff]] from Ramarno for 3,000 Barronite shards will give a 5% boost of getting the following 3 parts. The required pieces include:
*[[Barronite guard]], obtained from killing [[Golem (Ruins of Camdozaal)|golems]] within the dungeon.
*[[Barronite head]], obtained from crushing [[barronite deposit]]s.
*[[Barronite handle]], obtained from [[Fishing spot (Ruins of Camdozaal)|fishing]] within the dungeon.

The mace can be exchanged for 500 [[Barronite shards]] by showing it to [[Ramarno]].

==Trivia==
* Despite [[Barronite guard|one of the components of the mace]] being called a "guard," it is actually a pommel, as the guard offers no hand protection and is not where the mace is gripped; instead, the player grips the mace's [[Barronite handle|handle]] rather than the barronite guard itself.
*The barronite mace's value, of 10,500, is less than half of its three components combined value of 25,596.
* Despite being a [[mace]], the wielding sound and the set of attacks of the barronite mace match [[warhammer]]s. As a result, this weapon does not have a [[controlled]] [[stab]] attack similarly to the [[obsidian mace]]. However, unlike the other mace with a switched attack set, barronite mace does have a positive stab accuracy bonus.
* The barronite mace was originally going to have -4 in Stab, Magic, and Slash; +43 in Crush, and +48 Strength bonus.
